readme.markdown:
# cron-monitor-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: cron-monitor. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/cron-monitor

toolsPreview.name: ping_monitor
toolsPreview.description: Send a heartbeat ping to a cron monitor to confirm the job ran successfully. Use ping_type='ping' for simple heartbeats, 'start'+'complete' for duration tracking, or 'fail' to immediately mark it down.

toolsPreview.name: get_monitor_status
toolsPreview.description: Get the current status (up/down/grace/new) of a specific cron monitor along with last ping time and total ping count.

toolsPreview.name: get_dashboard
toolsPreview.description: Get an overview of all cron monitors — total count, counts per status (up/down/grace/new), and a summary list. Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: create_monitor
toolsPreview.description: Register a new cron job monitor. Returns the monitor ID to use in ping URLs. Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: list_monitors
toolsPreview.description: List all monitors with real-time computed status. Requires API key.

toolsPreview.name: get_ping_history
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the last 100 ping events for a monitor (type, timestamp, IP, duration for complete events). Requires API key.
